title: GEMglShadeModel

messages.description: symbolic value representing a shading technique

arguments.description: symbolic value representing a shading technique

body: [GEMglShadeModel] calls glShadeModel() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glShadeModel in the OpenGL reference.
